factualErrors: Section 3, Settings row says 'personalization, history, autoplay and assistant toggles change what Home shows'. Correct fact: the assistant (copilot) toggle only filters suggestions in the Create panel on `/templates/{slug}` and `/generate/{kind}` (`ctx.copilot` is passed to CreatePanel in those two pages; src/app/page.tsx never reads it). Only personalization, history and autoplay change Home.

Section 5, auth row says `POST /api/auth/signup`, `/api/auth/login`, `/api/auth/logout` are 'anon (rate limited)'. Correct fact: only signup (10 per hour per IP) and login (30 per 15 min per IP, 10 per 15 min per email) are rate limited; logout has no rate limit (map-api-routes.md section 2, src/app/api/auth/logout/route.ts).

Section 7, new-user walkthrough states the draft returns 451 `age_verification_required` for UK and listed US states. Correct fact at commit 9e1db60: `assertAgeVerified` is a stub that returns without checking anything; the only 451 that can fire today is `age_assurance_required`, raised by the legacy `AGE_ASSURANCE_STRICT_REGIONS` check in src/server/generation/service.ts:154-159 when that env var lists the country and the user is self-declared. The `age_verification_required` path is being added.

Section 4, Output row states 'nothing is served until the status is clean'. Correct fact: at this commit the media route and signed-URL issuance do not consult `scan_status` or `legal_hold`; the columns exist in the schema (default `pending`, `false`) and the scan hook returns `clean` without writing a verdict (src/server/safety/scan/index.ts). Enforcement at serve time is planned work for the scanning track.

Section 1, access-level note says the gate renders whenever the `hl_age_ok` cookie is absent on any path except `/policies*`. Correct fact: src/app/layout.tsx computes `ageOk = Boolean(user) || cookie === "1"`, so a signed-in user is never shown the age notice regardless of the cookie.

Section 5 adapter paragraph says production refuses to start on `SCAN_PROVIDER=dev`. Correct fact: src/server/env.ts:93 throws only when `SCAN_PROVIDER=dev` AND `SCAN_FAIL_CLOSED=true` (the default); setting `SCAN_FAIL_CLOSED=false` lets production start on the dev scanner.

Section 1.1, `/collection` row lists 'job tray' as an entry point. Correct fact: JobTray rows link to `/collection/{id}` (job-tray.tsx), not to `/collection`; the Library link comes from the create-panel toast's 'Library' action (create-panel.tsx:231).

problems: §8 (scanning, age verification, payments, installable web app) states enforcement as present fact ("Only assets scanned clean are served", "the asset goes under legal hold so purge and deletion skip it", "Members who need verification cannot generate, upload or see explicit content until verified", "a manifest, icons, standalone display, and a service worker"). At commit 9e1db60 the repo holds only the schema (drizzle/0002_launch_readiness.sql), env vars, adapter interfaces and no-op hook points: src/server/safety/scan/index.ts scanAsset() returns "clean" unconditionally and its own comment says "Until that track lands, these are no-ops"; src/server/age/gate.ts assertAgeVerified() is an empty function; src/server/push/notify.ts notifyJobFinished() is empty; src/server/payments/providers/ is an empty directory; there is no public/ directory, manifest, service worker, push API route or install control in settings.tsx; src/app/api/media/route.ts never reads scan_status or legal_hold; purgeDeletedMedia/purgeAssetsNow do not check legal_hold. The brief allows present tense for what the adapters do, but the only disclosure is one sentence in §9. §8 itself needs a sentence per block saying these run as scaffolded hook points being completed now, and which parts are sandboxed, so a reader does not take the enforcement claims as true of the current build.

§6 "Demo and sandbox states carry the iris Demo badge, an explanatory note, a watermark in the pixels and a labeled model name" conflates the two. The watermark and model name apply only to demo generation, and no sandbox label exists anywhere in the UI yet (grep for "sandbox" across src/app and src/components returns nothing). Scope the sentence to demo generation and label the sandbox UI treatment as part of the additions being built.

§5 System three labels the copilot paragraph "Demo: the engine is deterministic and the UI never calls it AI." The rules engine is fully built and operational (src/lib/copilot.ts, unit-tested); it is not a demo. The Built/Demo split the brief asks for is misapplied here. Reword (for example "Not AI:" or fold into Built) and keep "Demo" for placeholder output only.

§10 "On phones this is at risk today and is being fixed with a 'You' menu" is unverified. No code, plan.md entry or progress note shows this work; the mobile "You" tab today is a plain link to /settings (src/components/shell.tsx:197). The You-menu is only a proposal in the UX audit (gap 4). Label it planned or proposed, not in progress.

§8 age verification omits that AGE_VERIFICATION_FAIL_CLOSED defaults to "false" (src/server/env.ts:55): when no geo header is present and regions are configured, creation is allowed. §11 then claims "nothing explicit is made before age is established where the law requires it". A trust section should state the fail-open default on a missing header (or the owner's obligation to set the header and the flag), or the claim overstates.

§8 age verification lists "see explicit content" among the gated actions, but the scaffold has hook points only at draft creation (service.ts:162) and upload (uploads/route.ts:13); no view-side hook exists. Either label the viewing gate as being added or drop it from the present-tense list.
